issue.title: Say on each page of the reports list whether there is a next page
issue.body:
Our sync tool reads `GET /reports` page by page. Right now the only ways to know
we've reached the last page are to work it out from `total` and `pageSize`, or
to ask for one more page and get an empty `items` list back. People keep
creating reports while the tool runs, so `total` moves between requests and the
tool sometimes stops a page early. Could each page also carry the page count,
or a flag saying whether another page follows?

input.title: Add page count and has-next flag to paginated responses
input.body:
File: src/util/pagination.ts

The toPage function builds every paginated body as { items, total, page, pageSize }, so clients must infer the last page from total and pageSize. A pageCount helper already exists in this file but is not included in the response. Extend toPage so each page also carries pageCount (via the existing helper) and a hasNext boolean (page * pageSize < total, computed from the same total as the page), and add those fields to the Page type in src/types.ts. This lets a client that reads pages while reports are being created know from the response itself whether another page follows.
